interventions.what: text screen and GOAL.EXE memory (the state record [DS:A923] bytes +0x26/+0x28/+0x38/+0x3A/+0x3C/+0x3D/+0x40, the 3 countries' records at [DS:A917] + 0xBF c, the squad players' 20 record bytes at [DS:A91B] + 0x14 n, the surnames at [DS:9B6C] + 11 n and initials at [DS:9B70] + n, the derivation tables DS:6D25/DS:6DCD) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
savestates written at every read; one loaded (Host+L): the start state; every year-end capture's savestate staged as the next session's start state

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147), game folder recreated from the verified release copy, GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads the start state whose sha256 is given (e014-s1-y0.sav); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); DOS clock of this session not set
